ppo.normalization: Separate running norms. Collected normalized inputs frozen during update; only active raw rows update statistics after optimizer.

finite_job_contract.partial_reward: Preserve upstream reward cutoff and zero absorbing rewards. Add the registered completion credit at the terminal notification, including native partial terminal intervals. Never bootstrap the terminal.
finite_job_contract.initial_action_history: After physical initialization, project finite initial EMA and previous-action history into [-1,1]. Preserve nonfinite values for validation failure. Record original/projected history; no pose or noise changes.

training.initialization: Fresh randomly initialized policy and optimizer. No partial v3-r01, pilot, or diagnostic weights reused. This avoids unverified resume equivalence and unknown discarded-transition costs entering a primary resumed budget.
stop_conditions: Any invalid initialization stops the run and remains a failed request
Any nonfinite gradient/state or resource guard stops the run
Wall limit: 150 minutes; any partial checkpoints remain incomplete
training.checkpoint_rule: Save every completed cohort. Only the final predeclared 22-cohort checkpoint is the competence evaluation checkpoint. No choice based on development outcomes.

evaluation_schedule.during_training: CPU inspect periodic checkpoints and active/absorbing costs without additional simulator jobs or checkpoint selection
evaluation_schedule.after_budget: All 28 cases at development seeds 10070,10071,10072 using only r02 final budget weights; run IDs uniform_dev_<seed>_v3_r02. Original competence thresholds unchanged.

competence_gate.required: All 84 requests retained, all initializations valid, no forbidden events, finite checkpoint, exact budget. Force aborts, lost grasp, deadlines remain failures.
competence_gate.meaning: Development engineering gate for proceeding to sampler implementation, not industrial reliability, final-test performance, or a publication criterion.

training_prerequisites: Verified v3 control reruns with exact v2 physical parity and reward accounting
Frozen protocol_v3.json captures behavior hashes and verified gate evidence before launch
training.comparison_status: No adaptive run until competence gate passes. Future arms share architecture, reward, support, 25 percent nominal share, and charged training cost.

previous_cost_accounting.scope: Separate prior development/tuning costs, not hidden in the fresh v3 budget. Older shared development costs remain in their preserved evidence.

interrupted_v3_r01.reason: Lid/button sleep followed by the existing RAM resource guard.

scope_and_limitations: One uniform training seed, development only; no equal-cost method comparison or final-test result.
The reward correction needs fresh learning evidence and cannot retrospectively improve v2 outcomes.
Final-test seeds, combinations, gear and physics refinement remain unopened.

budget_accounting: Every full rollout slot including absorbing holds plus all measured initialization physics/decimation. All prior probes are shared development costs and must be reported separately; fault mining in future arms must be charged. No 20-epoch upstream throughput claim.
capacity_plan_amendment_before_launch: Use the five-cohort, 20-update bounded uniform pilot to measure longer stability instead of a second disposable five-cohort development optimization. Six shorter capacity probes already passed. Pilot weights start fresh and pilot cost is declared separately. This replaces only the planned final capacity measurement in training_adapter_development_plan_v1.json; previous plan and all runs remain preserved.
scope_and_limitations: One substantial fresh uniform development run; no final tests or adaptive comparison.
Frozen physical study configuration is inherited byte-for-byte from v2; the explicit v3 launcher adds only the registered reward correction.
Credit is an ideal absorbing-success value, not additional simulated successful behavior or force assurance.
Counterexamples on the diagnosed 19 successful scripted pairs are removed; global incentive alignment and learning competence remain unproven.
All original failures and prior development costs remain preserved; no weights reused.
change: Fresh replacement after external suspension and RAM-guard termination. Add preflight AC requirement and scoped idle-sleep request; scientific task, reward, training code, PPO, architecture, budget, and competence gate remain v3.

prior_failed_pilot_cost.classification: failed development/tuning cost; not hidden in replacement pilot budget

reward_correction.formula: Original finite v2 job reward plus ideal-success remaining-horizon credit, once after completed dwell.
